europe.text: Robert Hall and Michael Woodford receive the 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics for groundbreaking research on fiscal policy.
Houthi missile strikes force a major Saudi airport to close, prompting concerns over regional security and disrupting international conferences.
The EU imposes record sanctions on Russia, delivering an unprecedented economic blow to Kremlin leader Vladimir Putin.

latin-america.text: The Brazilian Supreme Court began hearings on a new anti-corruption bill aimed at tightening corporate accountability.
Argentina’s government announced a $2 billion investment in renewable energy projects across Patagonia.
Mexico’s oil regulator approved the construction of a new refinery in Veracruz to boost domestic fuel production.

oceania.text: Actress Selma Blair was arrested after allegedly biting a flight attendant during a turbulent flight.
FIFA president Infantino faces new allegations of receiving a secret salary, sparking fresh controversy.
Australia is being urged to join a seven‑nation initiative aimed at combating antisemitic violence.

middle-east.text: Houthis mocked Saudi missile power by using cheap drones to strike Saudi sites, claiming they cost far less than million‑dollar missiles.
A boat carrying Ethiopian migrants sank off Djibouti, killing 139 people in the tragic maritime disaster.
Gold prices rose as oil and the dollar fell, while markets await upcoming US inflation data.
Israel’s Netanyahu urged involvement in Yemen’s war, sparking debate over whether Saudi Crown Prince bin Salman opposes the move.

asia.text: Hundreds were detained in India as protesters demanded the resignation of the election commission chief.
Japan reported another deadly earthquake, adding to its string of recent natural disasters.
The Houthis intensified missile strikes on Gulf shipping, raising regional security concerns.

africa.text: African nations are drafting a strategic plan to boost reinsurance capacity, linking sovereignty with financial stability.
Algeria prioritises coastal infrastructure development over new weapons purchases, aiming to spur economic growth.
A tragic boat sinking off Djibouti killed 139 migrants fleeing Ethiopia, highlighting perilous migration routes.
Croatia’s Konaković met Saudi Arabia’s ambassador, jointly condemning Houthi attacks affecting Red Sea shipping.

north-america.text: Canada’s Mark Carney urges unity in a Thanksgiving message before his Alberta visit, saying the nation is stronger together than apart.
